question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is honored as illumination and all-power?
premises: It is illumination-natured and possesses all powers
It belongs to the two Śivas and is bowed to
inference: The supreme Eye of the two Śivas, of illuminating and all-powerful nature, is revered.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the dual śivayoḥ is not fully explicit in this unit.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all powers.
